title: Microsoft Copilot: build interactive reports and dashboards with Pages
summary: The briefing treats published Copilot Pages labelling coverage and prerequisites as unconfirmed for reports built in Pages, although Microsoft's documentation covers that class of content. The roadmap facts and control paths match their sources; the licensing model, policy caveats and Graph call need smaller corrections.
